item.title: Bratt Elementary Students Donate To Area Nursing Home Residents
item.description: Bratt Elementary School students collected items for area nursing home residents. The donations—including socks, lip balms, gloves, tissues, and lotions—were delivered Tuesday afternoon. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
